interpretation_boundary: Eight public-data scientific case claims with system-generated audit labels. These labels enable a descriptive external-artifact pilot but are not independent expert gold and cannot estimate benchmark accuracy.

sources.case_policy: The two claims deliberately separate reproduction of an observable from identification of its proposed material cause.

This case distinguishes reproducibility of the fixed eSSE estimator from a strict single-descriptor interpretation of cross-material path entropy. The latter is an audit stress test, not a verbatim assertion that the authors proposed an exact one-to-one conductivity law.

This case separates a deterministic reproduction of the public kMC initialization from a stronger mean-barrier sufficiency claim. The displayed witness is an explicitly exploratory maximum-ratio pair selected from all same-composition pairs within the declared tolerance, not a preregistered confirmation. The stronger claim is not attributed verbatim to the source authors, whose model explicitly includes local-environment-dependent barriers and correlated motion.
This candidate audits a deliberately scoped two-electrode parity model. It does not claim that every EIS equivalent circuit is non-identifiable or that the source authors overclaimed their results.
